tools.name: statuspage_list_pages
tools.description: List the status pages the API key can see, with ids, names and subdomains. Start here to get a page_id. API: GET /pages.

tools.name: statuspage_get_page
tools.description: Get the profile of one status page (name, subdomain, domain, time zone, notification settings). API: GET /pages/{page_id}.

tools.name: statuspage_list_components
tools.description: List the components of a page with their current status (operational, degraded_performance, partial_outage, major_outage, under_maintenance). API: GET /pages/{page_id}/components.

tools.name: statuspage_get_component
tools.description: Get one component with its status, group and description. API: GET /pages/{page_id}/components/{component_id}.

tools.name: statuspage_get_component_uptime
tools.description: Get uptime data for one component over a date range (default: the last 90 days). Dates are ISO 8601. API: GET /pages/{page_id}/components/{component_id}/uptime.

tools.name: statuspage_list_component_groups
tools.description: List the component groups of a page. API: GET /pages/{page_id}/component-groups.

tools.name: statuspage_list_incidents
tools.description: List incidents of a page, newest first. Use q to search by name, status or impact text. API: GET /pages/{page_id}/incidents.

tools.name: statuspage_list_unresolved_incidents
tools.description: List incidents that are not resolved yet (investigating, identified, monitoring). API: GET /pages/{page_id}/incidents/unresolved.

tools.name: statuspage_list_maintenances
tools.description: List scheduled maintenances of a page. kind: scheduled (all planned), upcoming (not started) or active (in progress). API: GET /pages/{page_id}/incidents/{scheduled|upcoming|active_maintenance}.

tools.name: statuspage_get_incident
tools.description: Get one incident with its full update timeline and affected components. API: GET /pages/{page_id}/incidents/{incident_id}.

tools.name: statuspage_count_subscribers
tools.description: Count the subscribers of a page by type (email, sms, webhook and others). API: GET /pages/{page_id}/subscribers/count.

tools.name: statuspage_list_metrics
tools.description: List the metrics shown on a page (for example response time). API: GET /pages/{page_id}/metrics.

tools.name: statuspage_update_component_status
tools.description: WRITE, public. Set the status of one component on the live status page. Visitors see the change at once. API: PATCH /pages/{page_id}/components/{component_id}.

tools.name: statuspage_create_incident
tools.description: WRITE, public. Create a real-time incident on the live status page. It is visible to visitors. With deliver_notifications true (the default of Statuspage) it also sends messages to subscribers. A second call creates a second incident. API: POST /pages/{page_id}/incidents.

tools.name: statuspage_update_incident
tools.description: WRITE, public. Post a new update on an incident: change its status, add update text, or set the status of components. Each call with body adds a new timeline entry and can notify subscribers, so do not repeat it. Setting status resolved closes the incident. API: PATCH /pages/{page_id}/incidents/{inc

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: statuspage_get_page, statuspage_count_subscribers · Private data: statuspage_list_pages · Public sink: statuspage_count_subscribers, statuspage_create_incident, statuspage_update_incident.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: statuspage_get_page, statuspage_count_subscribers · Private data: statuspage_list_pages · Public sink: statuspage_count_subscribers, statuspage_create_incident, statuspage_update_incident

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
